newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $29.72 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $29.72 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold all 600 million rupees ($29.72 million) of treasury bills it put up for its weekly auction, the central bank said on Friday.
The central bank sold 133.2 million rupees of 91-day bills at a weighted average yield of 10.33 percent at the Thursday auction against 183.0 million rupees at 10.50 percent last week.
The bank sold 155.4 million rupees of 182-day bills with an average yield of 10.64 percent against 217.4 million rupees at 10.69 percent last week.
The bank sold 311.4 million rupees of 364-day bills at an average yield of 10.61 percent against 249.6 million rupees at 10.69 percent last week.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 10.56 percent per annum from 10.64 percent last week, the bank said.
